title: apps/web/desktop.routes.json — the desktop shell export manifest (DR-P21-07)
description: Declares which [locale] routes the Tauri shell's static export keeps. Consumed by scripts/desktop-export-prebuild.mjs (the stash/restore build wrapper) and validated by /scripts/check-desktop-shell.ts at the repo root. The 'include' routes must exist as app/[locale]/<route>/page.tsx at build time (the prebuild fails loud listing every missing one).

include.description: The [locale] route segments the export keeps (route dirs under app/[locale]/). Each entry becomes app/[locale]/<entry>/ in the reduced build and <locale>/<entry>(.html|/index.html) in out-desktop/.

items.description: Single-segment or nested route path, lowercase kebab-case segments; no leading/trailing slash, no dot segments.

exclude.description: Non-route server surfaces the prebuild always removes for the export build (reserved names — a route may not shadow them).
